summary: This 8-K reports a routine refinancing: Extreme Networks entered a new 5-year, $500M revolving credit facility with JPMorgan as agent, replacing its existing facility with Bank of Montreal. Proceeds repaid outstanding debt; $200M drawn, $300M available. Interest is SOFR or base rate plus margin (1.25%-2.00% SOFR, 0.25%-1.00% base). Accordion feature allows incremental commitments. This is a standard credit agreement, not a special situation; no event relevant to M&A, activism, or capital structure changes. The filing is routine and does not merit special-situations classification.
